modules.name: std::bytes::buffer
modules.contract: Allocates explicitly; mutation can fail without corrupting the initialized prefix; deterministic and nonblocking.

modules.name: std::bytes::sequence
modules.contract: Borrows both inputs, performs no allocation, is deterministic, and does not block.

modules.name: std::containers::collections
modules.contract: Ownership transfer and allocation failure are explicit; ordering is deterministic only where the selected container or policy promises it.

modules.name: std::containers::errors
modules.contract: Stable typed failures for bounds, capacity, and empty-container operations; no allocation or blocking.

modules.name: std::containers::raw_array
modules.contract: Owns its allocation and exposes explicit failure; prefer the safe collection layer for new APIs.

modules.name: std::cryptography::hmac
modules.contract: Borrows key/message bytes, returns fixed-size tags, is deterministic and nonblocking, and reports invalid state or input length.

modules.name: std::cryptography::sha2
modules.contract: Borrows input and returns fixed-size digests; deterministic, nonblocking, and independent of host byte order.

modules.name: std::encoding::base64
modules.contract: Owning results allocate; decoding rejects malformed or noncanonical input; output is deterministic across platforms.

modules.name: std::encoding::binary
modules.summary: Endian primitives, bounded readers/writers, and varints
modules.contract: Explicitly bounded and endian-stable; growable buffers may allocate; malformed/truncated input returns typed errors without overread.

modules.name: std::encoding::hex
modules.contract: Owning results allocate; decoding validates complete byte pairs; deterministic and nonblocking.

modules.name: std::fmt
modules.summary: Typed formatting and console output facade
modules.contract: String formatting allocates and returns errors; console writes are blocking host I/O and preserve argument order.

modules.name: std::hashing::hashing
modules.contract: Borrows values, performs no allocation or blocking, and is deterministic only for the documented toolchain representation; never use for cryptography.

modules.name: std::io::buffered
modules.contract: Owns internal buffers, may allocate, and inherits blocking and error behavior from the wrapped stream.

modules.name: std::io::errors
modules.contract: Normalizes host failures into stable variants while preserving platform-dependent operation availability.

modules.name: std::io::file
modules.contract: Owns native handles, blocks on host I/O, requires explicit close where exposed, and reports portable I/O errors.

modules.name: std::io::filesystem
modules.contract: Reads allocate owning results; operations block and can vary with host permissions/filesystem semantics; errors are explicit.

modules.name: std::io::path
modules.summary: Lexical POSIX and Windows path manipulation
modules.contract: Lexical operations do not touch the filesystem; owning results may allocate; flavor selection makes platform rules explicit.

modules.name: std::io::stdio
modules.summary: Standard input, output, and error streams
modules.contract: Borrows written data, may allocate for line reads, blocks on host streams, and returns I/O or parse failures.

modules.name: std::io::stream
modules.summary: Reader/writer callable contracts and stream copying
modules.contract: Copying uses caller-visible errors and may block according to its endpoints; callables do not own endpoint storage.

modules.name: std::math::bits
modules.summary: Unsigned bit counting, rotation, reversal, and rounding
modules.contract: Pure, nonallocating, nonblocking, deterministic operations with checked overflow where a result may be unrepresentable.

modules.name: std::math::errors
modules.contract: Stable overflow and invalid-arithmetic variants; no allocation, blocking, or platform state.

modules.name: std::math::float
modules.contract: Pure and nonallocating; follows IEEE classification for supported target floats and is deterministic for the same bit pattern.

modules.name: std::math::integer
modules.summary: Integer predicates, powers, divisors, and overflow modes
modules.contract: Pure and nonallocating; checked, saturating, and wrapping behavior is named explicitly and target-width behavior follows the integer type.

modules.name: std::math::math
modules.summary: Ordered numeric minimum, maximum, clamp, absolute, and sign
modules.contract: Pure, deterministic, nonallocating operations; caller must provide an ordered clamp range.

modules.name: std::memory::errors
modules.contract: Stable bounds/range failures with no allocation, blocking, or partial mutation.

modules.name: std::memory::slices
modules.summary: Typed slice copying, filling, and swapping
modules.contract: Borrows storage, does not allocate or block, preserves overlap semantics, and validates before mutation.

modules.name: std::memory::storage
modules.summary: Initialized-prefix raw storage for owning containers
modules.contract: Owns allocation and explicit live-element state; unsafe internals are wrapped by lifecycle-preserving operations and allocation errors.

modules.name: std::net::address
modules.summary: IPv4, IPv6, and portable socket addresses
modules.contract: Parsing/formatting is deterministic; owning text may allocate; no network access occurs and address-family errors are explicit.

modules.name: std::net::dns
modules.contract: Returns owning address storage, may allocate and block on host resolution, and exposes platform/network failures.

modules.name: std::net::errors
modules.contract: Normalizes host socket and resolver failures while retaining explicit unsupported-family and address errors.

modules.name: std::net::tcp
modules.contract: Owns native sockets; connect, accept, read, and write block; close/shutdown and all host failures are explicit.

modules.name: std::net::udp
modules.contract: Owns a native socket; send/receive can block, datagram bounds are checked, and host behavior/errors are exposed portably.

modules.name: std::os::arguments
modules.contract: Allocates an owning string array, snapshots host arguments deterministically for the process, and reports allocation/conversion errors.

modules.name: std::os::environment
modules.contract: Reads allocate owning strings; operations affect process-global host state, may be platform-sensitive, and return explicit errors.

modules.name: std::os::errors
modules.contract: Stable argument/environment failures with platform details normalized at the runtime boundary.

modules.name: std::process::command
modules.summary: Child-process commands, pipes, and exit status
modules.contract: Command values own arguments; spawn creates native resources, wait and pipe I/O block, and termination/platform failures are explicit.

modules.name: std::process::errors
modules.contract: Normalizes spawn, pipe, wait, and unsupported-host failures without hiding abnormal termination status.

modules.name: std::random::errors
modules.contract: Separates entropy-source and range failures; deterministic generator methods do not report host entropy errors.

modules.name: std::random::generator
modules.contract: Owns only its small state, does not allocate or block for generation, and reproduces the documented sequence across supported targets.

modules.name: std::random::secure
modules.contract: Fills caller storage without allocation; may block at the OS boundary and reports unavailable/host entropy failures.

modules.name: std::tests::asserts
modules.contract: Borrows compared values, records failures in the test context, may allocate diagnostic text, and does not terminate the test by default.

modules.name: std::tests::benchmark
modules.contract: Runs supplied operations repeatedly, allocates sample storage, uses the monotonic clock, and returns configuration/operation errors.

modules.name: std::tests::fixtures
modules.summary: Temporary resources and seeded test data
modules.contract: Temporary fixtures own cleanup responsibility and perform blocking host I/O; seeded data is deterministic; failures are explicit.

modules.name: std::tests::golden
modules.contract: Reads/writes files synchronously, makes update mode explicit, allocates diagnostics, and returns I/O or mismatch failures.

modules.name: std::tests::testing
modules.contract: Owns test name/state, records deterministic counts, may allocate diagnostics, and exposes failures without hidden process exit.

modules.name: std::text::ascii
modules.contract: Pure byte-oriented operations with no allocation, errors, blocking, locale, or platform dependence.

modules.name: std::text::errors
modules.summary: Text parse, format, and UTF-8 errors
modules.contract: Stable typed failures for conversion and validation; declaring/propagating them does not allocate or block.

modules.name: std::text::strings
modules.summary: String building, search, trim, transform, replace, parse, and format
modules.contract: Views borrow input; owning transformations allocate; byte/ASCII semantics are explicit; parsing and formatting return errors.

modules.name: std::text::utf8
modules.summary: UTF-8 validation, decoding, counting, and encoding
modules.contract: Borrows byte-oriented strings, does not allocate, is deterministic, and reports exact malformed/truncated input errors.

modules.name: std::time::clock
modules.summary: Monotonic instants, wall timestamps, and sleep
modules.contract: Clock reads use host state; sleep blocks; elapsed monotonic durations are stable while wall time and precision are platform-dependent.

modules.name: std::time::duration
modules.contract: Value operations do not allocate or block; normalization and checked arithmetic are deterministic across targets.

modules.name: std::time::errors
modules.contract: Stable overflow, range, and host-clock failures with no hidden fallback behavior.
